_note: REFERENCE ONLY. Apify does not read this file — configure pay-per-event pricing in the Apify Console (Publication > Monetization). Event names must match src/main.ts EXACTLY: 'page-scraped' for normal fetches and 'page-rendered' for JavaScript-rendered pages. This file just records the values you should enter.

page-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once each time a page is successfully fetched, cleaned, and converted to Markdown. Failed pages are not charged.

page-rendered.eventDescription: Charged once per page when JavaScript rendering is enabled. Rendering runs a real browser and uses much more compute, so it is priced higher. Failed pages are not charged.
